test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is speed?

options.text: It is the distance covered by an object in a unit time.
It is the velocity of an object per unit time.
It is the force applied on covering a unit distance.
It is the acceleration of an object per unit time.

solution: The correct answer is **__It is the distance covered by an object in a unit time__**.
